principle: Corpus acquisition and validated analysis run in production; experimental instruments remain isolated until efficacy validation and documentation are approved.

lifecycle_states.production: May run in the standard observatory analysis lane within its declared scope.
lifecycle_states.evidence_capture_only: May collect evidence for later review, but may not publish an institutional scientific conclusion automatically.
lifecycle_states.experimental: Development only; prohibited from the production analysis runner.

admission_requirements: documented validation or efficacy evidence appropriate to the instrument type
explicit output scope and prohibited inferences
production entrypoint with fail-closed registry enforcement

instruments.label: Auditoria descritiva de acesso restrito
instruments.may_infer: Counts and descriptive categories produced from explicit access-surface fields and documented non-incorporation categories in the materialized corpus.
instruments.must_not_infer: Institution-wide absence/presence of restrictions beyond observed records, causal effects, or completeness of holdings.

instruments.label: Indicador descritivo de registros públicos materializados
instruments.may_infer: Share of public versus restricted records among records actually materialized under the current corpus rules and declared denominator.
instruments.must_not_infer: Overall institutional openness, total holdings, audiovisual visibility index, or population-representative access rates.

instruments.label: Captura heurística de evidências de infraestrutura digital
instruments.may_infer: Detected signals and reviewed evidence on the observed URL/date according to the evidence lifecycle.
instruments.must_not_infer: Institution-wide technology or AI use from an unreviewed heuristic signal; absence of a signal as absence of a technology.

instruments.label: M3 — tipagem de superfícies digitais
instruments.may_infer: Development-only outputs until independent validation is executed.
instruments.must_not_infer: Production classification accuracy, validated generalisation, or M4 eligibility.

instruments.label: M4 — elegibilidade binária de superfície de item
Avaliação de relevância do motor de busca
instruments.may_infer: Nothing beyond engineering behavior until retrieval evaluation is completed.
instruments.must_not_infer: Precision, recall, ranking quality, or exhaustive findability.

instruments.label: Índice composto de visibilidade audiovisual digital
instruments.may_infer: Nothing until a versioned definition and validation exist.
instruments.must_not_infer: Overall visibility score from current partial indicators.
